functions.name: Combiner.CombineTextByDelimiter
functions.signature: Combiner.CombineTextByDelimiter(delimiter as text, optional quoteStyle as nullable number) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that combines a list of text using the specified delimiter.

functions.name: Combiner.CombineTextByEachDelimiter
functions.signature: Combiner.CombineTextByEachDelimiter(delimiters as list, optional quoteStyle as nullable number) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that combines a list of text using a sequence of delimiters.

functions.name: Combiner.CombineTextByLengths
functions.signature: Combiner.CombineTextByLengths(lengths as list, optional template as nullable text) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that combines a list of text using the specified lengths.

functions.name: Combiner.CombineTextByPositions
functions.signature: Combiner.CombineTextByPositions(positions as list, optional template as nullable text) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that combines a list of text using the specified output positions.

functions.name: Combiner.CombineTextByRanges
functions.signature: Combiner.CombineTextByRanges(ranges as list, optional template as nullable text) as function
functions.summary: Returns a function that combines a list of text using the specified positions and lengths.
